items.q: his daughter, Irene Williams, was singing with the group.

ctx.x: So you were out on bail.

And while I was out on bail I joined Herman Chittison and went to Florida. The Court said I could go anywhere I wanted to as long as I was out on bail, just as long as I was in Court on my due date. So I went to Miami during the '52-'53 Season, you know, winter, Hialeah, '52 going into '53, that's the season, you know, in the winter, and I played Mother Kelly's and Clarence Williams, the legendary Clarence Williams, pianist, he's in all these books, his daughter, Irene Williams, was singing with the group. And…
she was young and pretty. So one night we were -- we had left the Mother Collins Club and moved down to the next block.
